subject: Quick sync: StoreWave self-serve trial — clarify workload & lock demo window
messages:
From: Ami Patel <ami@storewave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial signup — quick demo?

Hi Ben,

I just started a self-serve trial this morning (signed up via the dashboard) and wanted to see if we could get a quick demo to walk through inference routing and cost controls. We're evaluating Redwood to replace our current in-house serving stack for StoreWave's recommendation engine.

Quick context:
- Use case: real-time personalized product recommendations and reranking for web + mobile checkout flows
- Traffic: currently ~200k inference calls/month, expected to grow to ~1M/month over next 6 months; peak concurrent QPS ~18–22
- Latency target: 50–150ms p95 for recommendations (90 tokens avg)
- Timeline: decision timeline ~end of Q3; want to pilot in July

Can you do a 30-min walkthrough this week? Prefer early mornings PST.

Thanks,
Ami Patel
Head of ML, StoreWave
ami@storewave.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ami Patel <ami@storewave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial signup — quick demo?

Hi Ami — welcome and thanks for signing up. I’m Ben (SDR) on the account — happy to set up a short walkthrough and surface the parts of the platform that map to your latency and cost goals. A few quick questions so we tailor the call: 

1) Are the 200k (to 1M) calls/month mostly short-lived single-turn generations (recommendations only) or do you have multi-step scoring/reranking flows that keep contexts / KV cache warm?
2) What does a typical request payload look like (avg tokens in / out)? You mentioned ~90 tokens — is that request, response, or total?
3) Do you need private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) or is hosted API OK for the pilot?
4) Any requirements on data residency / encryption beyond standard SOC2?

Propose three 30-min slots (PST) — pick one and I’ll calendar it:
• Tue Jun 1 — 9:00 AM
• Tue Jun 1 — 11:00 AM
• Wed Jun 2 — 8:30 AM

I attached a short intake form that helps our solutions team prep — can you fill the "traffic profile" section before the call? (attachment: storewave-intake-form.pdf)

Cheers,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Ami Patel <ami@storewave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 07:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial signup — quick demo?

Hi Ben,

Thanks — appreciate the quick reply. A couple answers inline:  
- Flow shape: primarily single-turn recommendation calls, but we have a separate rerank step that takes the top 50 candidates and scores them (so occasional multi-step). KV cache helpful for user session affinity but not strictly required initially.
- Tokens: ~30 tokens avg request, ~60 avg response (so ~90 total) — p95 response length slightly higher at ~140 tokens
- Hosted API is fine for the pilot; we may need a private/pinned option later on
- Compliance: SOC2 is fine; we'll need a short review of data retention settings but no additional certs right now

Can we move the earliest slot to Wed Jun 2 9:00 AM PST instead? My morning on Tue is blocked with customer calls. Any chance of Wed at 9?

Also uploaded a small snippet of sample payloads to support@storewave.com in case Monica or your solutions engineer wants to review ahead of time.

—Ami

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ami Patel <ami@storewave.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial signup — quick demo?

Hi Ami — Monica here from Solutions Engineering. Thanks for the details — that helps. A couple of quick technical follow-ups to make the demo productive: 

1) For the rerank step (top-50), do you run that synchronously within the same request path or as an independent batch job? If synchronous, we'll want to look at model choice + batching strategy in the call.
2) Can you confirm p95 latency SLA during peak traffic (you noted 50–150ms) — is 150ms an acceptable target for rerank, or do you need lower for checkout flows?
3) If you can send the sample payloads (thanks for uploading) and a 1–2 example prompts/responses, I'll prepare a small runbook and a sample prompt set (attachment: sample-prompts.csv) so we can show a realistic perf/cost comparison in the demo.

If Wed Jun 2 9:00 AM PST works, I’ll block 45 minutes (30 demo + 15 Q/A) so we can also sketch a quick pilot plan.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
